e|it seems to me.name: it seems to me
e|it seems to me.gloss: 우리는 교통 체증을 피하기 위해 좀 더 일찍 출발해야 할 것 같아.
e|it seems to me.after: that we should leave a bit earlier to avoid traffic.
e|it seems to me.why: 내가 보기에는 그렇다는 말은 It seems to me예요.
e|it seems to me.line: It seems to me that we should leave a bit earlier to avoid traffic.

e|arguably.name: arguably
e|arguably.gloss: 여기가 아마 이 동네에서 가장 맛있는 피자집일 거야.
e|arguably.after: the best pizza place in town.
e|arguably.why: 단정하지 않고 그렇다고 볼 만하다는 말은 arguably예요.
e|arguably.line: This is arguably the best pizza place in town.

e|by and large.name: by and large
e|by and large.gloss: 전반적으로 이곳의 날씨는 일 년 내내 꽤 온화해요.
e|by and large.after: , the weather here is pretty mild all year.
e|by and large.why: 대체로 그렇다는 말은 By and large예요.
e|by and large.line: By and large, the weather here is pretty mild all year.

e|more or less.name: more or less
e|more or less.gloss: 회의가 우리가 예상한 대로 거의 진행됐어.
e|more or less.why: 거의 그렇다는 말은 more or less예요.
e|more or less.line: The meeting went more or less as we expected.

e|that said.name: that said
e|that said.gloss: 나는 정말 피곤하지만, 그렇다고 해도 네가 프로젝트를 끝내는 것을 도와줄게.
e|that said.after: , I’ll help you finish the project.
e|that said.why: 앞의 말을 인정하고 다른 말을 덧붙일 때는 that said를 써요.
e|that said.line: I’m really tired; that said, I’ll help you finish the project.

e|needless to say.name: needless to say
e|needless to say.gloss: 비가 올 것 같으면 우산을 가져가는 게 당연해요.
e|needless to say.after: , you should bring an umbrella if it looks like rain.
e|needless to say.why: 말할 필요도 없이 당연하다는 말은 Needless to say예요.
e|needless to say.line: Needless to say, you should bring an umbrella if it looks like rain.

e|for the time being.name: for the time being
e|for the time being.line: Let's keep the windows closed for the time being.

e|to put it mildly.name: to put it mildly
e|to put it mildly.gloss: 어제 날씨가 매우 추웠다는 말로도 부족해요.
e|to put it mildly.why: 말보다 실제가 더 심하다는 완곡한 표현은 to put it mildly예요.
e|to put it mildly.line: The weather was cold yesterday, to put it mildly.

e|be that as it may.name: be that as it may
e|be that as it may.gloss: 그렇다 하더라도, 우리는 여전히 내일까지 프로젝트를 끝내야 해.
e|be that as it may.after: , we still have to finish the project by tomorrow.
e|be that as it may.why: 그렇다 해도 넘어간다는 말은 Be that as it may예요.
e|be that as it may.line: Be that as it may, we still have to finish the project by tomorrow.

e|for the record.name: for the record
e|for the record.gloss: 분명히 말하지만, 나는 그 계획에 동의한 적 없어.
e|for the record.after: , I never agreed to that plan.
e|for the record.why: 분명히 밝혀 둔다는 말은 for the record예요.
e|for the record.line: Just for the record, I never agreed to that plan.

e|a grey area.name: a grey area
e|a grey area.before: Whether that's allowed or not is kind of
e|a grey area.why: 분명하게 갈리지 않는 영역은 a grey area예요.
e|a grey area.line: Whether that's allowed or not is kind of a grey area.

e|in hindsight.name: in hindsight
e|in hindsight.gloss: 지나고 보니 오늘 우산을 챙겼어야 했어요.
e|in hindsight.after: , I should have packed an umbrella today.
e|in hindsight.line: In hindsight, I should have packed an umbrella today.

e|with all due respect.name: with all due respect
e|with all due respect.gloss: 외람되지만, 다른 선택지를 고려해야 한다고 생각해요.
e|with all due respect.after: , I think we should consider another option.
e|with all due respect.why: 공손하게 이견을 말할 때는 With all due respect를 써요.
e|with all due respect.line: With all due respect, I think we should consider another option.

e|on the fence.name: on the fence
e|on the fence.gloss: 이번 달에 헬스장에 등록할지 아직 결정하지 못했어.
e|on the fence.after: about joining the gym this month.
e|on the fence.why: 아직 어느 쪽으로도 정하지 못했다는 말은 on the fence예요.
e|on the fence.line: I'm still on the fence about joining the gym this month.

e|the bottom line.name: the bottom line
e|the bottom line.gloss: 가장 중요한 것은 우리가 이 프로젝트를 금요일까지 끝내야 한다는 거야.
e|the bottom line.after: is we need to finish this project by Friday.
e|the bottom line.why: 결국 가장 중요한 점은 The bottom line이에요.
e|the bottom line.line: The bottom line is we need to finish this project by Friday.

e|not to mention.name: not to mention
e|not to mention.gloss: 하이킹이 길고 힘들었고, 끝에는 정말 진흙투성이였다.
e|not to mention.before: The hike was long and tiring,
e|not to mention.why: 거기에 더해 또 있다는 말은 not to mention이에요.
e|not to mention.line: The hike was long and tiring, not to mention really muddy at the end.

e|bear in mind.name: bear in mind
e|bear in mind.gloss: 일요일에는 가게가 일찍 문을 닫는다는 점을 기억하세요.
e|bear in mind.after: that the store closes early on Sundays.
e|bear in mind.why: 잊지 말고 새기라는 말은 bear in mind예요.
e|bear in mind.line: Just bear in mind that the store closes early on Sundays.

e|read between the lines.name: read between the lines
e|read between the lines.gloss: 가끔은 전체 이야기를 이해하려면 속뜻을 읽어야 해요.
e|read between the lines.why: 겉으로 말하지 않은 뜻을 읽는다는 말은 read between the lines예요.
e|read between the lines.line: Sometimes you have to read between the lines to get the full story.

e|beside the point.name: beside the point
e|beside the point.gloss: 내일 비가 오는지 여부는 지금 중요하지 않아.
e|beside the point.why: 핵심과 상관없다는 말은 beside the point예요.
e|beside the point.line: Whether it rains tomorrow is beside the point right now.

e|a blessing in disguise.name: a blessing in disguise
e|a blessing in disguise.gloss: 지갑을 잃어버렸는데 누군가가 모든 것이 그대로인 채로 찾아서 돌려줘서 오히려 좋은 일이었다.
e|a blessing in disguise.after: because someone found it and returned it with everything inside.
e|a blessing in disguise.why: 당장은 나빠 보여도 나중에 좋은 일은 a blessing in disguise예요.
e|a blessing in disguise.line: Losing my wallet was actually a blessing in disguise because someone found it and returned it with everything inside.

e|the elephant in the room.name: the elephant in the room
e|the elephant in the room.gloss: 우리 모두가 모르는 척하는 분명한 문제를 그냥 무시할 건가요?
e|the elephant in the room.before: Are we just going to ignore
e|the elephant in the room.why: 모두가 알지만 아무도 꺼내지 않는 문제는 the elephant in the room이에요.
e|the elephant in the room.line: Are we just going to ignore the elephant in the room?
